map.自定义长度与字符集，生成高强度安全随机密码。: Generate strong, secure random passwords with a custom length and character set.
map.使用密码学安全随机源（crypto.getRandomValues）生成，可配长: Generated with a cryptographically secure random source (crypto.getRandomValues), configurable in length and character set (upper- and lowercase letters, digits, symbols). Password strength is measured by information entropy:
map.建议长度 ≥12、熵 ≥80 bit；含符号可显著提升抗暴力破解。: A length of ≥12 and entropy of ≥80 bits is recommended; including symbols noticeably improves resistance to brute force.
map.避免词典词与个人信息；生成后妥善保存，前端不留存。: Avoid dictionary words and personal information; store the result safely — nothing is kept on the front end.
map.纯浏览器生成，不离开本地。: Generated entirely in the browser; nothing leaves your device.
map.仅保存在当前标签页，关闭标签页后自动清除。: Kept only in the current tab and cleared automatically when the tab is closed.
map.密码长度比复杂度更重要，16位随机密码远强于8位复杂密码: Password length matters more than complexity; a 16-character random password is far stronger than an 8-character complex one
map.每个账户使用不同密码，使用密码管理器管理: Use a different password for every account and manage them with a password manager
map.不要使用生日、姓名、qwerty、123456等常见密码: Do not use birthdays, names, qwerty, 123456 or other common passwords
map.由多个单词组成的密码短语更容易记忆且更安全: A passphrase made of several words is easier to remember and also more secure
map.重要账户密码建议每90天更换一次: Change the password for important accounts roughly every 90 days
map.重要账户务必开启双重验证: Always turn on two-factor authentication for important accounts
map.不要通过邮件、即时通讯等方式发送密码: Never send passwords by email, instant messaging or similar channels
map.使用专业密码管理器，不要明文存储在文档中: Use a dedicated password manager; never store passwords in plain text in documents
map.给新服务生成初始口令：一次生成足够长的高熵口令存进密码管理器，避免沿用旧口令或自: Create initial credentials for a new service: generate a long, high-entropy password and store it in your password manager instead of reusing an old one or making one up.
map.16 位含四类字符：`Tq7!mK9@pL2#vX4z`（熵约 95 位）。: 16 characters with all four character classes: `Tq7!mK9@pL2#vX4z` (about 95 bits of entropy).
map.随机含四类字符 12+ 位可抗在线爆破，离线需更长。: A random password of 12+ characters drawn from all four classes resists online brute force; offline attacks call for more.
map.为什么有的网站不接受我生成的口令？: Why do some sites reject the password I generated?
map.通常是字符限制：部分系统不允许某些符号、限制长度上限，或要求必须包含（或禁止包含: Usually it comes down to character restrictions: some systems disallow certain symbols, cap the length, or require (or forbid) particular character classes. A few systems also mishandle special characters in transit or at rest. In that case, regenerate within the character set the site allows rather than shortening the password to fit the rules.
